title: UBAG Helper Node Allocation (consumer schema)
description: One capacity grant for one Helper Node, as the external Fleet Manager publishes it and as the UBAG primary consumes it (ADR-0006: UBAG places work only inside granted capacity and never provisions hosts). This is an interface proposal handed to the fleet-manager team: the manager owns the producer, UBAG owns this schema. Contains no secrets, tokens, tenant ids or job ids; the SPKI pin and URI SAN are public certificate identity. cpu_millis and memory_bytes are ALREADY NET of any reservations the manager holds for its own workloads, so UBAG never subtracts again. The UBAG-side ceiling table (1.5 CPU / 2.5 GiB, 3 / 5 browsers, 75% / 62.5%) is defence-in-depth only: effective cap = min(grant, ceiling). Consumer rules: generation is monotonic per node_id and a grant with a lower generation than the last accepted one is stale and rejected; a grant past valid_until, or one whose reservation_state is unknown, authorises no new placements (work already placed keeps its limits); state draining accepts no new placements and revoked authorises nothing and fences the node (UBAG-WORKER-NODE-FENCED-005); when the manager is unreachable the last-known-good grant stays in force but is never increased. The allocation_list definition is the polled response body.

schema_version.description: Incremented only for a breaking change. additionalProperties is false, so producers must not emit fields this version does not define.

node_id.description: Stable manager-assigned node identity; must equal the node identity in the certificate URI SAN.

endpoint.description: WireGuard-reachable host:port of the helper's mTLS gRPC server. The primary dials this; it is never a public address.

uri_san.description: URI SAN the helper certificate must present; carries the node identity.

spki_sha256.description: Optional lowercase hex SHA-256 of the SubjectPublicKeyInfo to pin. Certificates live at most 72h, so a pin is only meaningful per issued certificate.

cpu_millis.description: Granted CPU in millicores, net of manager reservations.

memory_bytes.description: Granted memory in bytes, net of manager reservations.

reservation_state.description: known: cpu_millis and memory_bytes are net of the manager's reservations. unknown: the manager could not determine its own reservations, so the numbers are not trustworthy and authorise no new placements.

max_browser_workloads.description: Concurrent browser workloads the node may run (one active operation per provider session identity still applies on top).

voice_capable.description: True only when the node can terminate voice media; requires udp_port_range and nat_ip.

udp_port_range.description: Bounded UDP port range opened for WebRTC media (min <= max, checked by the consumer).

nat_ip.description: NAT 1:1 public address advertised in ICE candidates.

valid_until.description: The grant authorises no new placements after this instant.

generation.description: Monotonic per node_id; also the fencing token, so results from an older generation are rejected.

allocations.description: At most one entry per node_id.
